lead_story: The US and Japan have taken joint action to prop up the yen, the US used most of its long-range precision missiles during the Iran war, and Fed officials are signaling potential rate hikes to address inflation, all of which are influencing the current macroeconomic landscape and creating uncertainty in the markets, the de-escalation hopes in Iran are also affecting oil prices and treasury yields
